{{Navbar-GOGPT-tracker}}
'''Rosignano power station''' is an operating power station of at least 536-megawatts (MW) in Rosignano Solvay, Rosen, Toscana, Italy.

==Background==

This power station provides 505 MW of electricity in cogeneration, part of which is supplied to Solvay's Rosignano chemical plant.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.lungomarecastiglioncello.it/rosign_solvay/ros_solv_fabbrica/Rosig_S_fabbri_43.htm|title=Rosignano Solvay la fabbrica-Roselectra - La centrale elettrica turbogas|website=www.lungomarecastiglioncello.it|access-date=2022-05-09}}</ref>
